recommendation: Keep the source fix unless FM later makes an explicit decision that Claim.insurer or Claim.provider should be optional in the current release.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FM change request asking that Claim.use, Claim.patient, Claim.insurer, and Claim.provider have 1..1 cardinality.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-19457 implementation commit was found. Current source already had Claim.use at 1..1 and Claim.subject, the current patient-bearing element with a patient alias, at 1..1. Claim.insurer remained 0..1, and Claim.provider was 1..1 on the R4B branch but was later relaxed to 0..1 by the unkeyed f952b532 FHIR core updates commit.
additional_context: Claim is active current build source in fhir.ini. Later Claim.provider issues FHIR-22689 and FHIR-20171 clarified comment wording without approving optional provider cardinality. FHIR-19458, already audited on the combined branch, added Patient and RelatedPerson to Claim.enterer and does not supersede the Claim.provider requirement. Community searches found no conflicting FHIR-19457 record.
reconciliation: Changed source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml so Claim.insurer.min and Claim.provider.min are 1. No change was needed for Claim.use or Claim.subject.

source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml: changed Claim.provider minimum cardinality from 0 to 1.
